metadata.description: Compatibility copy of Seelen UI v2.8.10 toolbar integration. Derived from eythaann/Seelen-UI; AGPL-3.0.

plugin.template:
return isMuted
  ? icon("IoVolumeMuteOutline")
  : volume >= 0.66
    ? icon("IoVolumeHighOutline")
    : volume >= 0.33
      ? icon("IoVolumeMediumOutline")
      : volume != 0
        ? icon("IoVolumeLowOutline")
        : icon("IoVolumeOffOutline")
